summary: First full test run of CalcyTub. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 pytest cases) covering health, public content (overrides/articles/settings), admin JWT auth (valid/invalid/no-token/bad-token), overrides PUT/GET/DELETE, articles POST/PUT/DELETE + publish toggle + duplicate-slug + 404s, settings PUT with restore — 23/23 passed. Frontend: verified homepage/hero/popular cards, header search dialog -> navigation, /calculators lists exactly 30 calculators, /categories (10 cards incl. coming-soon) and /category/finance (8 calcs), all 30 calculator pages compute with correct math for the specified example values, reset button, error state (a=0 quadratic), disabled Calculate on empty input, Formula/How It Works/Worked Example/FAQ/Related sections, all 5 legal pages + about + contact (mailto only, no form), 404 page, admin login (wrong creds error, valid login, tabs, sign out clears token), calculator override saved in admin and reflected on public /calculator/bmi-calculator (incl. document.title from seoTitle), article create -> visible on /articles and /articles/test-qa-article, and mobile (390px) header collapse/hamburger/stacked inputs/no horizontal overflow. Test data (override + article) was cleaned up afterwards. Math verified: EMI ₹43,391.16; BMI 22.49 Normal; 12.5%; H2SO4 98.07 g/mol; speed 10 m/s (36 km/h); pH 4 Acidic; roots 3 & 2; SIP ₹23,23,390.76; FD ₹1,41,477.82; mortgage P&I $2,022.62 + tax $366.67 + PMI $0 (LTV 80%); BMR 1568/TDEE 2430; Devine 65.94kg; fraction 5/6; gcd 6/lcm 36; density 1000; dilution V2=1; personal EMI ₹16,607.15 — all correct.

minor.issue: Dead code via public ingress — only /api/* is routed to :8001, so the FastAPI robots.txt is never served publicly. Public /robots.txt is served by /app/frontend/public/robots.txt (Emergent default content-signals file) which does NOT contain 'Disallow: /admin'. Either move the route under /api or write the desired robots.txt into frontend/public/.

No sitemap exists — public /sitemap.xml returns the SPA index.html (200 HTML). robots.txt references /sitemap.xml. For an SEO-first site a real sitemap (build-time generated from ALL_CALCULATORS + articles) is missing.
No validation that slug corresponds to a real calculator and no whitelist of override field names — any arbitrary key/value can be persisted into overrides.json.

integration_issues.issue: settings.adsenseClient is editable in admin but never consumed anywhere in the frontend (no AdSense script injection). siteName/tagline are only used on the About page; header/footer/contact page use hardcoded strings, so changing settings has almost no visible effect.
Only one [data-testid=ad-slot] exists and only on calculator detail pages. Homepage, category, calculators index and article pages have zero ad placeholders despite the AdSense monetization goal.

issues: Molar mass of H2SO4 renders as 98.07 (2 decimals) while the documented/expected precision is 98.079 g/mol; chemistry results would benefit from 3-4 significant decimals.

Meta title/description/canonical are injected client-side only (CSR React, no SSR/prerender). Titles, descriptions and canonicals were verified correct in the browser, but crawlers that do not execute JS will only see the static index.html — worth noting for an 'SEO-first' requirement.
Very little content above the footer on 1920x1080 leaves a large empty band; minor visual emptiness only, no layout break.

action_items: Serve robots.txt from frontend/public (including Disallow: /admin) or move the route under /api — the current backend route is unreachable publicly and the shipped robots.txt is the Emergent default.
Add a real sitemap.xml (build-time generated) since robots.txt points at it and the site is SEO-first.
Wire settings.adsenseClient into the frontend (AdSense script) and add ad-slot placeholders on homepage/category/article pages, or drop the unused setting.
Increase decimal precision for chemistry results (molar mass shows 98.07 vs 98.079).
Optional hardening: validate override slug against ALL_CALCULATORS and whitelist override field keys in PUT /api/admin/overrides.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: overrides/articles JSON writes are non-atomic and not lock-protected; concurrent admin writes can truncate/corrupt content files. Consider write-to-temp + os.replace.
server.py: @app.get('/robots.txt') is defined outside the /api router, so it can never be reached through the k8s ingress.

AdminPage.jsx (233 lines) mixes login, overrides, articles and settings panels in one file; splitting into components would help maintainability. Overrides panel also seeds textareas with base values, so saving persists full copies of default text as 'overrides'.
JWT is stored in localStorage; acceptable for a single-admin tool but XSS-exposed.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created override for bmi-calculator and article slug 'test-qa-article' via admin UI; both deleted after verification. overrides.json = {} and articles.json = [] restored. Settings tagline restored by test teardown.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is a template with NO credentials — admin/changeme123 was taken from the review request and backend/.env. Main agent should record admin creds in that file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 tests, all passing; run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`). It self-cleans overrides/articles/settings. All 30 calculators were computed via UI with default inputs and math verified correct. Remaining untested/low-value areas: admin article edit-in-place (only publish toggle + delete exercised via UI), keyboard '/' search shortcut, article unpublish reflected on /articles UI. Open items are SEO infra (robots.txt/sitemap.xml) and unused adsenseClient setting — no functional bugs found.
rca_of_the_issue: robots.txt: Kubernetes ingress routes only /api/* to backend:8001; a FastAPI route registered at the app root ('/robots.txt') therefore only resolves on localhost:8001, while the public URL falls through to the CRA static file. Fix requires putting SEO files in frontend/public or namespacing them under /api.
